newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Treasury ups ENI offer to 1.1 bln shares.
newsitem.headline: Italy Treasury ups ENI offer to 1.1 bln shares.

text.p: The Italian Treasury announced on Thursday that it was increasing the total number of shares of energy giant ENI being offered for sale to 1.1 billion, from 700 million.

A Treasury statement said an over- allotment or "green- shoe" option could be exercised for up to 15 percent of the new global share offer. The previous offer had been 700 million shares with a green-shoe option of up to 105 million shares. Public subscription for the second-tranch offer in Italy is from October 21 to October 25 and the share price will be fixed on October 26. Trading starts on October 28.

The Treasury statement said that it had been advised by the coordinators of the offering, Italian investment bank IMI and CS First Boston, that "demand for the shares from the Italian public and institutional investors, already strong in the first place, had increased further."
Although the Treasury did not quantify the number of shares exercisable under the new "green shoe" option, 15 percent of 1.1 billion is 165 million.
ENI shares closed 1.45 percent off at 7,295 on the Milan bourse on Thursday.
In November 1995, the Treasury sold a first 15 percent tranche of ENI shares at 5,250 lire a share to trade in Milan London and New York, which raised 6.3 trillion lire.
